text: ABSTRACT: Driven by the rapid development of 5G/6G communications, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence, the metallization of high-aspect-ratio through-holes (THs) in printed circuit boards (PCBs) imposes stringent requirements on the thickness uniformity and interconnect reliability of electroplated copper layers.
